81:T166f,function solve(task, deadline) {
  const q = task.q, a = task.a, half = q / 2;
  const n = task.n, m = task.m, kcols = n - m;
  const TARGET = 14;

  // Basis of {x : A x = 0 mod q}, A = [I_m | A'] ; x = (x1 in Z^m, x2 in Z^kcols)
  const B = [];
  for (let j = 0; j < kcols; j++) {
    const v = new Array(n).fill(0);
    v[m + j] = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) {
      let x = (((-a[i][j]) % q) + q) % q;
      if (x > half) x -= q;
      v[i] = x;
    }
    B.push(v);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) {
    const v = new Array(n).fill(0);
    v[i] = q;
    B.push(v);
  }

  function gso(M) {
    const mm = M.length;
    const mu = [], Bn = new Float64Array(mm), bs = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < mm; i++) {
      const bi = Float64Array.from(M[i]);
      const mi = new Float64Array(mm);
      for (let j = 0; j < i; j++) {
        let d = 0;
        for (let t = 0; t < n; t++) d += M[i][t] * bs[j][t];
        const c = d / Bn[j];
        mi[j] = c;
        const bj = bs[j];
        for (let t = 0; t < n; t++) bi[t] -= c * bj[t];
      }
      let s = 0;
      for (let t = 0; t < n; t++) s += bi[t] * bi[t];
      Bn[i] = s;
      bs.push(bi);
      mu.push(mi);
    }
    return { mu, Bn };
  }

  function lll(M, endT) {
    const delta = 0.99;
    for (;;) {
      const z = M.findIndex(r => r.every(x => x === 0));
      if (z >= 0) { M.splice(z, 1); continue; }
      const { mu, Bn } = gso(M);
      const mm = M.length;
      let k = 1, restart = false;
      while (k < mm) {
        if (Date.now() > endT) return;
        for (let j = k - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
          if (Math.abs(mu[k][j]) > 0.5) {
            const r = Math.round(mu[k][j]);
            const bk = M[k], bj = M[j];
            for (let t = 0; t < n; t++) bk[t] -= r * bj[t];
            mu[k][j] -= r;
            for (let i = 0; i < j; i++) mu[k][i] -= r * mu[j][i];
          }
        }
        if (M[k].every(x => x === 0)) { M.splice(k, 1); restart = true; break; }
        const lhs = Bn[k];
        const rhs = (delta - mu[k][k - 1] * mu[k][k - 1]) * Bn[k - 1];
        if (lhs >= rhs) {
          k++;
        } else {
          const tmp = M[k]; M[k] = M[k - 1]; M[k - 1] = tmp;
          const m0 = mu[k][k - 1];
          const B2 = Bn[k] + m0 * m0 * Bn[k - 1];
          mu[k][k - 1] = m0 * Bn[k - 1] / B2;
          Bn[k] = Bn[k - 1] * Bn[k] / B2;
          Bn[k - 1] = B2;
          for (let j = 0; j < k - 1; j++) {
            const t = mu[k][j]; mu[k][j] = mu[k - 1][j]; mu[k - 1][j] = t;
          }
          for (let i = k + 1; i < mm; i++) {
            const t = mu[i][k];
            mu[i][k] = mu[i][k - 1] - m0 * t;
            mu[i][k - 1] = t + mu[k][k - 1] * mu[i][k];
          }
          k = Math.max(1, k - 1);
        }
      }
      if (!restart) return;
    }
  }

  let nodes = 0, stopT = 0;
  function enumBlock(M, mu, Bn, k, beta) {
    const end = Math.min(M.length, k + beta);
    let R = Bn[k] * 0.99;
    let bestX = null;
    const x = new Array(M.length).fill(0);
    let abort = false;
    function rec(t, partial, nzLater) {
      if (abort) return;
      if (((++nodes) & 1023) === 0 && Date.now() > stopT) { abort = true; return; }
      if (t < k) {
        if (nzLater && partial < R) {
          R = partial * 0.9999;
          bestX = x.slice(k, end);
        }
        return;
      }
      let c = 0;
      for (let s = t + 1; s < end; s++) c -= x[s] * mu[s][t];
      const rad = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, (R - partial) / Bn[t]));
      const lo = Math.ceil(c - rad - 1e-9), hi = Math.floor(c + rad + 1e-9);
      for (let v = lo; v <= hi; v++) {
        const d = v - c;
        const np = partial + Bn[t] * d * d;
        if (np >= R) continue;
        x[t] = v;
        rec(t - 1, np, nzLater || v !== 0);
        if (abort) break;
      }
      x[t] = 0;
    }
    rec(end - 1, 0, false);
    return bestX;
  }

  let best = null, bestL = Infinity;
  const check = (v) => {
    let mx = 0, nz = false;
    for (let t = 0; t < n; t++) {
      const x = Math.abs(v[t]);
      if (x > mx) mx = x;
      if (x !== 0) nz = true;
    }
    if (nz && mx < bestL) { bestL = mx; best = v.slice(); }
  };

  const endT = deadline - 800;
  lll(B, endT);
  let tour = 0;
  while (Date.now() < endT && bestL > TARGET) {
    for (const r of B) check(r);
    const K = Math.min(30, B.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < K && bestL > TARGET; i++)
      for (let j = i + 1; j < K && bestL > TARGET; j++) {
        const s = new Array(n), d = new Array(n);
        for (let t = 0; t < n; t++) { s[t] = B[i][t] + B[j][t]; d[t] = B[i][t] - B[j][t]; }
        check(s); check(d);
      }
    if (bestL <= TARGET) break;

    const beta = tour < 2 ? 8 : (tour < 4 ? 12 : 16);
    tour++;
    stopT = endT;
    let improved = false;
    for (let k = 0; k + beta <= B.length && Date.now() < endT && bestL > TARGET; k++) {
      const g = gso(B);
      const u = enumBlock(B, g.mu, g.Bn, k, beta);
      if (u) {
        const v = new Array(n).fill(0);
        for (let t = 0; t < u.length; t++) {
          if (u[t] !== 0) for (let s = 0; s < n; s++) v[s] += u[t] * B[k + t][s];
        }
        B.splice(k, 0, v);
        lll(B, endT);
        improved = true;
        check(v);
      }
    }
    if (!improved) {
      for (let it = 0; it < 2000 && Date.now() < endT && bestL > TARGET; it++) {
        const v = new Array(n).fill(0);
        const cnt = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
        for (let c = 0; c < cnt; c++) {
          const r = B[Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.min(40, B.length))];
          const sg = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
          for (let t = 0; t < n; t++) v[t] += sg * r[t];
        }
        check(v);
      }
    }
  }

  if (best === null) best = B[0].slice();
  return best;
}
